paragraphs: Nice work, team. Winter 2027 is at 669 of 700 (96%), and the BYUI market is at 83%, so we're well ahead. The cancellation deadline is this Wednesday, November 4. Before then, let's get the 13 Unapproved residents and the 72 still choosing a bed through to approval. Work the 53 inactive leads too, starting with Carriage House (17) and Haven Blue (11). Every contract after Wednesday counts toward a full Winter, so Winter stays our focus until it's full. Don't pivot to Spring yet.
Also, remember Ava's advice from manager training. Make a personal connection, or add a personal touch, with each resident this semester. Our easiest customers are the ones who already live with us.
